ex.en: Simple changes at home can help conserve water and electricity.
ex.zh: 家中一些简单的改变有助于节约水和电。

words.note: 指保护自然资源或节约能源，比 save 更正式。

ex.en: He suffered a stroke last year but has recovered almost completely.
ex.zh: 他去年中风，但已基本康复。

words.note: 指中风、一击或笔画，a stroke of luck 指运气。

ex.en: The farm breeds horses for racing and for sale abroad.
ex.zh: 这家农场繁育赛马，并销往国外。

words.note: 过去式与过去分词同为 bred，注意这一不规则变化。

ex.en: The boys teased him about his new haircut all through lunch.
ex.zh: 整个午饭时间男孩们都拿他的新发型取笑他。

words.note: tease sb about sth 拿某事取笑某人，语气较轻。

ex.en: Do not make a rash decision before you know all the facts.
ex.zh: 弄清全部事实之前不要草率做决定。

words.note: 作形容词指轻率鲁莽，作名词指皮疹。

ex.en: The fragrance of jasmine filled the whole garden after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后茉莉的芳香弥漫整个花园。

words.note: 指好闻的香味，比 smell 更雅，作名词可数。

ex.en: Good time management helps students balance study and part-time work.
ex.zh: 良好的时间管理帮助学生在学习和兼职之间取得平衡。

words.note: 指管理或管理层，作主语时谓语可用复数。

ex.en: The mechanic found a crack in one of the engine cylinders.
ex.zh: 机械师发现其中一个发动机气缸有裂缝。

words.note: 指圆柱体或气缸，gas cylinder 指煤气罐。

ex.en: The soldiers defended the fort against repeated attacks for weeks.
ex.zh: 士兵们数周来抵御一次又一次进攻，守住了堡垒。

words.note: 指堡垒；hold the fort 指临时顶替负责。

ex.en: Leave home early to avoid the rush hour traffic.
ex.zh: 早点出门以避开高峰时段的交通。

words.note: 后接动名词 avoid doing，不能接不定式。

ex.en: The government ordered a comprehensive review of the safety rules.
ex.zh: 政府下令对安全规定进行全面审查。

words.note: 强调全面广泛，comprehensible 则指可理解。

ex.en: Workers spent five years digging a tunnel through the mountain.
ex.zh: 工人们花了五年时间挖通一条穿山隧道。

words.note: 作动词表挖隧道，过去式可双写 l 再加 ed。

ex.en: The teacher assigned each group a different topic for the presentation.
ex.zh: 老师给每个小组分配了不同的演讲题目。

words.note: assign sth to sb 把某物分给某人，也可指布置。

ex.en: She withdrew some cash from the bank before catching her train.
ex.zh: 她在赶火车前去银行取了些现金。

words.note: 指撤回或取钱，过去式为 withdrew。

ex.en: The instructions were so straightforward that anyone could follow them.
ex.zh: 说明非常简明，任何人都能照做。

words.note: 由 straight 加 forward 构成，表直截了当。

ex.en: The architect showed us an elaborate design for the new library.
ex.zh: 建筑师向我们展示了新图书馆的精巧设计。

words.note: 作形容词表精心制作的，elaborate on 指详述。

ex.en: She is an expert in international trade law and teaches at the university.
ex.zh: 她是国际贸易法专家，并在大学任教。

words.note: an expert in/on sth 指某领域的专家。

ex.en: The city's population has doubled over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 过去二十年里，这座城市的人口翻了一番。

words.note: 指十年，复数 decades，常用 over the past decade。

ex.en: He finally fulfilled his childhood dream of becoming a pilot.
ex.zh: 他终于实现了儿时成为飞行员的梦想。

words.note: 指履行义务或实现愿望，英式拼作 fulfil。

ex.en: A large crowd gathered outside the stadium to welcome the players.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集在体育场外欢迎球员。

words.note: a crowd of 指一群人，be crowded with 表挤满。

ex.en: Scientists from forty countries attended the congress on cancer research.
ex.zh: 来自四十个国家的科学家参加了这次癌症研究大会。

words.note: 指代表大会或国会，特指机构时首字母大写。

ex.en: The flight was delayed by a minor mechanical problem in the engine.
ex.zh: 航班因发动机的一个小机械故障而延误。

words.note: 指机械的，也形容动作呆板、缺乏感情。

ex.en: Ancient kings often claimed that their power came from divine will.
ex.zh: 古代国王常宣称自己的权力来自神的意志。

words.note: 指神的、天赐的，口语里也表极好的。

ex.en: The novel describes the slaughter of thousands during the civil war.
ex.zh: 这部小说描写了内战期间数千人被屠杀的惨状。

words.note: 指屠杀或屠宰，语气强烈，多用于负面。

ex.en: A foul smell from the river made the whole neighbourhood complain.
ex.zh: 河水散发的臭味让整个街区怨声载道。

words.note: foul 指气味难闻，foul play 指犯规或谋杀。

ex.en: The factory increased its output by twenty percent last year.
ex.zh: 这家工厂去年产量提高了百分之二十。

words.note: 指产量或输出，与 input 相对，通常不可数。

ex.en: The carpet was covered with an intricate pattern of flowers and birds.
ex.zh: 地毯上布满了花鸟的繁复图案。

words.note: 强调细节繁多而复杂，多形容图案、情节。

ex.en: After the long march, many soldiers suffered from extreme fatigue.
ex.zh: 长途行军后，许多士兵极度疲劳。

words.note: 不可数名词，指极度疲劳，比 tiredness 正式。

ex.en: He lay in agony on the ground until the ambulance arrived.
ex.zh: 他躺在地上痛苦不堪，直到救护车赶到。

words.note: 指剧痛或精神折磨，in agony 表极度痛苦。

ex.en: She is contemplating moving to another city for a better job.
ex.zh: 她正在考虑搬到另一座城市，以获得更好的工作。

words.note: contemplate doing sth 考虑做某事，较正式。
